I replied to Pree in a thread in #central-random: the ticket is #8841.

Tobias posted it in that channel on Oct 13 at 09:27. He wrote that West yard Door 2 at the Plains depots still double-books when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on #8841. His message calls it "Tobias's dealer account" and doesn't name Marrow Fieldworks. I think that's the same account, because the Central handoff digest calls Marrow Fieldworks a dealer account that changed hands on Jan 5. Neither post says so outright, though.

I also told her not to mix it up with #88412, an older Tansleigh Packaging ticket with a similar number.

I only used channels Pree is in and public files.
